parser-zh.note: The expression-parser session in Chinese, as a normal three-column desktop window in the app's own dark appearance: the session rail on the left, the transcript in the middle, the workspace's files on the right (the Context panel, opened from its own header button, on its Files tab, with `src` and `benches` expanded). `?theme=dark` pins the appearance the way `?lang=` pins the words, and `?settings=approvalTier:sandbox` pins the approval mode, so the frame is the restricted tier rather than full access — the composer says 沙箱保护 and the card below is what that costs the reader. The window is a 16-inch laptop's default 1728×1117 at 2×. The transcript stands on the second turn — the benchmark — because the approval card and the chart take the room two turns do not share: `上一个问题` walks back to that question and an `eval` sets the column so the question sits 8 px under the header (the press alone lands on the reply when the answer grows), and the frame then reads question → folded process → the benchmark table and its trade-off → the throughput chart → the card, with the diagnosis one screen above.

steps.eval: (() => { const col = [...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(d => (d.className || '').includes('floating-scrollbar h-full')); const q = [...col.querySelectorAll('p')].find(p => (p.textContent || '').startsWith('别处还有同样的写法吗')); if (!q) throw new Error('the second question is not in the transcript'); col.scrollTop += Math.round(q.getBoundingClientRect().top - (col.getBoundingClientRect().top + 8)); return 'question at ' + Math.round(q.getBoundingClientRect().top); })()

(() => { const text = document.body.innerText; if (text.includes('invalid_history_transfer')) throw new Error('the transcript did not load: the history read failed'); if (!document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) throw new Error('the frame is not in the dark appearance'); if (!text.includes('诊断')) throw new Error('the session lost its diagnosis'); if (text.includes('Diagnosis')) throw new Error('the Chinese frame carries the English transcript'); if (text.includes('Files') || text.includes('Expand context panel') || text.includes('Previous question') || text.includes('Allow once') || text.includes('Deny')) throw new Error('the Chinese frame carries an English control'); if (text.includes('完全访问') || text.includes('Full access')) throw new Error('the frame is on full access, not a restricted tier'); if (!text.includes('沙箱保护')) throw new Error('the composer does not name the sandboxed tier: ' + (text.match(/手动审批|沙箱保护|完全访问|自动审批/) || ['none'])[0]); const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(s => (s.innerText || '').includes('需要在沙箱外运行此命令')); if (!card) throw new Error('the approval card is not rendered'); const cardText = card.innerText; if (!cardText.includes('git push origin fix/parser-bound')) throw new Error('the card does not show the command it is asking about'); if (!cardText.includes('原因说明') || !cardText.includes('CI')) throw new Error('the card has no reason'); if (!cardText.includes('允许一次') || !cardText.includes('拒绝')) throw new Error('the card has no allow/deny actions'); const img = document.querySelector('article img'); if (!img) throw new Error('the reply has no inline image'); if (!img.complete || img.naturalWidth < 1000) throw new Error('the inline image did not decode: ' + img.naturalWidth + 'x' + img.naturalHeight); const aside = [...document.querySelectorAll('aside')].find(a => (a.innerText || '').includes('文件')); if (!aside) throw new Error('the files panel is not open'); const tree = aside.innerText; for (const name of ['parser.rs', 'args.rs', 'tests.rs', 'parser-throughput.png', 'Cargo.toml', 'AGENTS.md', '.github']) { if (!tree.includes(name)) throw new Error('the file tree does not list ' + name); } const col = [...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(d => (d.className || '').includes('floating-scrollbar h-full')); if (!col) throw new Error('no conversation column'); const colTop = col.getBoundingClientRect().top; const ps = [...col.querySelectorAll('p')]; const shown = ps.find(p => { const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.bottom > colTop && r.top < 1117; }); if (!shown) throw new Error('no paragraph is on screen'); const first = shown.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!(shown.textContent || '').includes('别处还有同样的写法吗')) throw new Error('the frame does not start at the second question'); if (first.top < colTop - 1) throw new Error('the second question is not at the top of the frame: ' + Math.round(first.top)); const cardBox = card.getBoundingClientRect(); const imgBox = img.getBoundingClientRect(); if (imgBox.bottom > cardBox.top - 4) throw new Error('the chart runs under the approval card: ends at ' + Math.round(imgBox.bottom) + ', the card starts at ' + Math.round(cardBox.top)); const composer = document.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]'); if (!composer) throw new Error('no composer'); if (cardBox.bottom > composer.getBoundingClientRect().top + 1) throw new Error('the approval card is not fully above the composer'); return 'ok: card ' + Math.round(cardBox.top) + '..' + Math.round(cardBox.bottom) + ', chart ends ' + Math.round(imgBox.bottom) + ', image ' + img.naturalWidth + 'x' + img.naturalHeight; })()

parser-en.note: The same session in English — the same bug, the same benchmark, the same two commits and the same sandboxed push, written in the language of the frame, in the same dark window at the same restricted tier. `?lang=en` pins both halves (the interface via shot/prefs.ts and the fixture's own session list, transcript and approval card) and `?theme=dark` / `?settings=approvalTier:sandbox` pin the appearance and the tier; the taps are the same controls as the Chinese scenario, by their English names.
